extracted.name: Almond eggless cake
extracted.description: This is my mother's recipe. She used to make on sundays for evening snack
instruction_lines: Melt butter and keep it to cool
In separate bowl mix both the flour, baking powder and soda bi carbonate
Add condensed milk with butter and mix 10 to 15 mins.
Now add 3tbs flour and little soda, and mix. Like this mix all the flour and soda and continue to mix throughly
Now add tuti fruity, and pour the batter in silicon mould and keep in preheated (200°) oven and bake for 25 min
Once cool, take out the cakes and enjoy with coffee
